review: Every sourced frame listed here was visually inspected against its mapped movement. Related variants are disclosed in captions. Original PNGs are bundled offline and are not fetched by the app.

excludedSourceSlugs.lat-pulldown: Behind-the-neck pulldown does not match the guide's front pulldown.
excludedSourceSlugs.assisted-dip: Shows a seated dip press machine, not a counterweight-assisted parallel-bar dip.
excludedSourceSlugs.reverse-pec-deck: Shows a forward-facing chest fly, not reverse fly facing the chest support.
excludedSourceSlugs.dead-bug: Head/limb depiction was not suitable for the intended instruction.
excludedSourceSlugs.crunch: Feet are elevated on a bench, unlike the guide's feet-on-floor variant.
excludedSourceSlugs.bench-dip: Shows an advanced feet-elevated variant, unlike the guide's bent-knee feet-on-floor variant.
excludedSourceSlugs.lying-leg-curl: Small schematic roller and frame are hard to distinguish; replaced by a clearer side-view illustration.
